title: Taipei Confucius Temple

terrainReference.basis: Dry central frontforecourt beyond LingxingGate and north of PanPond; fixed before terrain/geometry. PondPOI lies further south; do not anchor in water.

note: Principal fifteen-part ceremonial compound with photo/official-plan interpreted enclosures and approximate three-arch Pan Bridge. Native components retained independently; modern Minglun Hall, service buildings, neighboring temples, pond water/interior excluded. Original independent third-party published claimed NLSC2024 20mDTM remains unaltered, including all open courts. Source preview only; no terrain cutout/flattening or generic footprint replacement.
